```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(mgcv)
library(zoo)
library(tidymodels)
library(modeltime)
library(timetk)
# library(iml)
# library(fs)
# library(patchwork)

source('functions.R')

theme_set(theme_minimal())
p <- params
```

# 1. Doel & Opzet (vaste kolomnamen)

We bouwen drie modellen per **compartiment** met
**tidymodels‑workflows** en gebruiken **exact de kolomnamen** uit jouw
bestanden:

- **`pp_wide.csv`**: `compartiment` (wordt hernoemd naar `compartment`),
  `date`, **parameters** `PBmax`, `alpha`, `Eopt`, `Kd`, `chl_surface`,
  plus `turbidity`, `conversionEtoC`, `irradiance_J_cm2`.
- **`knmi_daily.csv`**: `datum`, `STN`, `parameter`, `value`, `unit`
  (waarbij **`parameter == "Q"`** globale instraling is). Eenheden zijn
  **J/cm²/dag** of **J/m²/dag** afhankelijk van `unit`.
- **`monthly_mean_integrated_ppp.csv`**: `date`, `compartment` *(of
  `compartiment`)*, `PP_depth_integrated` (hernoemd naar `PP_observed`).

Alle **drie** modellen zijn **tidymodels‑workflows**: 1)
**LM/interpolatie** (recipe‑only met `step_ts_impute(method='linear')`)
2) **GAM** (`gen_additive_mod(engine='mgcv')`, log‑schaal,
**lange‑termijn** + **seizoens** spline) 3) **STM** (`prophet_reg()`)
met **trend + Fourier‑seizoenen + spring‑bloom** basissen.

De parameters voeden de **Eilers–Peeters** fotoinhibitie‑vergelijking;
vervolgens integreren we over **diepte** (exponentiële lichtverzwakking)
en **tijd** (daggemiddelde of `hours_per_day`).

> **Bronnen**: Eilers & Peeters (1988) en de EP‑implementatie in
> `phytotools`/CRAN, die exact dezelfde functionele vorm gebruikt
> citeturn12search45turn12search46turn12search44. Voor
> **PAR‑conversie** hanteren we de vuistregel **4.57 µmol J⁻¹** en
> **PAR‑fractie** van kortgolvige straling (defaults 0.45), conform
> gangbare horticulture‑/ecofysica‑documentatie en het R‑pakket
> **bigleaf** (defaults 4.6 µmol J⁻¹; 0.5)
> citeturn12search41turn12search38. De KNMI‑parameter **Q** is
> globale straling (J/cm² per tijdvak) in de operationele definities en
> wordt door ons per dag geaggregeerd/ gemiddeld over stations
> citeturn12search19turn12search18. Voor **GAM‑splines** (waaronder
> `bs='cc'` cyclisch) volgen we **mgcv** documentatie
> citeturn12search25turn12search29. **Prophet** (STM) is gebaseerd
> op Taylor & Letham (2017/2018) citeturn12search30turn12search35.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 2. Theorie & vergelijkingen

## 2.1 Omrekening straling → PAR (daggemiddeld)

We gebruiken **KNMI** globale straling **Q** (J/cm²/dag of J/m²/dag).
Eerst naar **J/m²/dag**: $$E_{\mathrm{J\,m^{-2}\,d^{-1}}} =
\begin{cases}
\texttt{value} \times 10^{4}, & \text{als unit = J/cm}^2/\text{dag}\\
\texttt{value}, & \text{als unit = J/m}^2/\text{dag}
\end{cases}$$ Neem vervolgens de fractie die in het **PAR‑spectrum**
valt ($f_{PAR}$) en zet energie om naar fotonen met
$\kappa \approx 4.57\,\mu\mathrm{mol\,J^{-1}}$ (zonlicht‑gemiddeld):
$$\mathrm{PAR}_{\mathrm{mol\,m^{-2}\,d^{-1}}} = f_{PAR} \cdot E_{\mathrm{J\,m^{-2}\,d^{-1}}} \cdot (\kappa\cdot 10^{-6})$$
Daggemiddelde **PAR** (µmol m⁻² s⁻¹) over 24 uur:
$$\overline{I}_0 = \mathrm{PAR}_{\mathrm{mol\,m^{-2}\,d^{-1}}} \cdot \frac{10^{6}}{86400}$$
Als **KNMI** ontbreekt gebruiken we `irradiance_J_cm2` uit **pp_wide**
als fallback (zelfde conversie, met J/cm²/dag → J/m²/dag).
citeturn12search41turn12search38turn12search19turn12search18

## 2.2 Lichtverzwakking met diepte

We nemen **Beer–Lambert** demping met **extinctiecoëfficiënt** $K_d$
(m⁻¹): $$I(z) = \overline{I}_0\; \exp(-K_d\, z), \qquad z \in [0,H]$$

## 2.3 Eilers–Peeters (EP) met fotoinhibitie

We gebruiken de **drie‑parameter** EP‑vorm met $\alpha$ (initiële
helling), $E_{opt}$ (optimale belichting), en $P_{B\max}$
(massaspecifieke maximale productie). Met $E\equiv I$ (µmol m⁻² s⁻¹):
$$P_B(E)\;=\; \frac{E}{\;\dfrac{E^2}{\alpha\,E_{opt}^2}\; +\; \dfrac{E}{P_{B\max}}\; -\; \dfrac{2E}{\alpha\,E_{opt}}\; +\; \dfrac{1}{\alpha}\;}\quad\left[\,\frac{\mathrm{mg\,C}}{\mathrm{mg\,chla\,h}}\,\right]$$
Deze vorm is equivalent aan de implementatie in **phytotools::fitEP** en
leidt tot een **fotoinhibitie‑piek** bij $E\approx E_{opt}$
citeturn12search44turn12search45.

## 2.4 Dagelijkse diepte‑integratie

Met **uniforme** chlorofylconcentratie
$C_{chl}(z)\equiv C_{chl,\,surf}=\texttt{chl\_surface}$ (µg L⁻¹ ≡
mg m⁻³) en kolomhoogte $H$ (m):
$$P_{\mathrm{day}} = \int_0^{T} \int_0^{H} P_B\big(I(z)\big)\;C_{chl,\,surf}\;\mathrm{d}z\;\mathrm{d}t
\approx T\,\int_0^{H} P_B\big(\overline{I}_0\,e^{-K_d z}\big)\;C_{chl,\,surf}\;\mathrm{d}z$$
waar $T$ het aantal te integreren uren per dag is (default **24**).
Numerieke integratie verloopt met trapezia over **dz** (default 0.25 m).
Resultaat in **mg C m⁻² d⁻¹**.

## 2.5 Modelvergelijkingen (parameters op log‑schaal)

**Model 1 (LM/interpolatie)**\
Voor elke parameter
$\theta_t \in \{\,P_{B\max},\alpha,E_{opt},K_d, C_{chl,\,surf}\,\}$:
lineaire interpolatie in de tijd via `step_ts_impute(method='linear')`
(tidymodels‑recipe).

**Model 2 (GAM)**\
Voor elke parameter (op **log‑schaal**):\
$$\log\theta_t = f_{LT}(t) + f_{SEAS}(\mathrm{doy}(t)) + \varepsilon_t,$$
met $f_{LT}$ een thin‑plate spline (*bs="tp"*) en $f_{SEAS}$ een
**cyclische** kubische spline (*bs="cc"*) op dag‑van‑het‑jaar.
Smoothingparameters via REML. citeturn12search25turn12search29

**Model 3 (STM)**\
Voor elke parameter (log‑schaal) een **additief** model:
$$\log\theta_t = g(t) + s_{Fourier}(t) + s_{bloom}(t) + \varepsilon_t,$$
waar **`prophet_reg()`** de trend $g(t)$ en Fourier‑seizoenen schat;
**spring‑bloom** wordt gemodelleerd via Gaussische basissen rond
DOY‑centra (tune‑baar). citeturn12search30turn12search35

**SHAP‑decompositie (STM)**\
We groeperen features in **long_term**, **seasonal** (Fourier), en
**spring_bloom** en sommeren SHAP‑bijdragen per groep (iml::Shapley).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 3. Data inlezen & voorbereiden

```{r data}
# pp_wide

pp <- read_csv(file.path(p$input_path, p$files_pp_wide), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(compartment = compartiment) %>%
  mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment))   # <-- type afdwingen

# KNMI (datum, STN, parameter, value, unit)
dir_knmi <- read_delim(p$files_knmi_daily, delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)
knmi <- dir_knmi %>%
  mutate(datum = ymd(datum)) %>%
  compute_incident_PAR_knmi(f_par = p$f_par, umol_per_J = p$umol_per_J)   # -> date + PAR

# calculation done in preparation script (but format differs)
# knmi <- read_csv(file.path(p$input_path, p$files_daily_par))

# ============================================================
# Observations aggregated by month (current workflow)
# ============================================================

# Observaties (PP)
obs_monthly <- read_delim(p$files_pp_obs, show_col_types = FALSE, delim = ";") %>%
  mutate(date = as_date(as_date(paste(year, month, "15")))) %>%
  rename(
    PP_observed = monthlyMean,
    compartment = compartiment
  ) %>%
  # mutate(compartment = as.character(compartiment)) %>%
  select(date, compartment, PP_observed)


# ============================================================
# Use observations on exact dates (new workflow)
# ============================================================

obs_exact <- read_delim(
  "../../data/Deltares/combined_ppp/pp_integrated_exact_dates.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  delim = ";"
) %>%
  rename(
    compartment = compartiment
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    compartment = as.character(compartment)
  ) %>%
  select(date, compartment, PP_observed)

# ============================================================
# Choose which one to use
# ============================================================

obs <- obs_exact

# Fallback PAR uit pp_wide (irradiance_J_cm2)
par_pp <- compute_incident_PAR_from_pp(pp, f_par = p$f_par, umol_per_J = p$umol_per_J)  # date + PAR_pp

# Combineer: KNMI prefereerd
PAR <- prefer_knmi_PAR(knmi, par_pp)

# Merge voor modellering
pp_all <- pp %>% left_join(PAR, by = 'date') %>% arrange(compartment, date)

# Replace alpha outliers (values > 0.05) with NA
pp_all <- pp_all %>%
  mutate(alpha = if_else(alpha > 0.05, NA_real_, alpha))

comps <- unique(pp_all$compartment)
length(comps); head(comps)
```

# 4. Modellen fitten per compartiment (tidymodels)

```{r fit, warning=FALSE}

pred_dates <- tibble(
  date = seq.Date(
    as.Date("1990-01-01"),
    as.Date("2024-12-31"),
    by = "day"
  )
)

# Different bloom centers based on measurement analysis
p$stm_bloom1_center <- 75 # 117
p$stm_bloom2_center <- 95 # 190

dirs <- c(p$out_dir_lm, p$out_dir_gam, p$out_dir_stm)
sapply(dirs, dir.create)

fits <- map(comps, function(cp){
  d <- filter(pp_all, compartment == cp)
  list(
    lm  = fit_model_tidy_realcols(d, model = 'lm'),
    gam = fit_model_tidy_realcols(d, model = 'gam'),
    stm = fit_model_tidy_realcols(d, model = 'stm', stm_cfg = list(
      fourier_K = p$stm_fourier_K,
      bloom1_center = p$stm_bloom1_center,
      bloom1_sigma  = p$stm_bloom1_sigma,
      bloom2_center = p$stm_bloom2_center,
      bloom2_sigma  = p$stm_bloom2_sigma
    ))
  )
})

names(fits) <- comps
```

```{r predict}
    stm = make_predictions_realcols(fit_list$stm, irradiance_df = PAR, compartment = cp, out_dir = p$out_dir_stm, dz = p$dz, hours = p$hours_per_day, default_bottomdepth = p$default_bottomdepth)
```

```{r pp-ts, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
#     theme_minimal()

plot_pp_timeseries <- function(pred_df, obs_df, cp){

  obs_sel <- obs_df %>%
    mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)) %>%
    filter(compartment == as.character(cp), !is.na(PP_observed))

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = pred_df,
      aes(date, PP_model, colour = "Model")
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = obs_sel,
      aes(date, PP_observed, colour = "Observed"),
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(Model = "#1f77b4", Observed = "#d62728")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5500)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Compartment:", cp),
      y = "Depth-integrated PP (mg C m^-2 d^-1)",
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

#example_cp <- as.numeric(comps[7])

i <- 7
example_cp <- comps[i]

pp_ts_lm  <- plot_pp_timeseries(preds[[example_cp]]$lm,  obs, example_cp)
pp_ts_gam <- plot_pp_timeseries(preds[[example_cp]]$gam, obs, example_cp)
pp_ts_stm <- plot_pp_timeseries(preds[[example_cp]]$stm, obs, example_cp)
pp_ts_lm  / pp_ts_gam  / pp_ts_stm
```

```{r}
get_r2 <- function(pred_df, obs_df, cp){

  obs_sel <- obs_df %>%
    mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)) %>%
    filter(compartment == as.character(cp),
           !is.na(PP_observed))

  df <- inner_join(
    obs_sel,
    pred_df,
    by = "date"
  )

  cor(df$PP_observed, df$PP_model)^2
}

get_r2(preds[[example_cp]]$lm, obs, example_cp)
get_r2(preds[[example_cp]]$gam, obs, example_cp)
get_r2(preds[[example_cp]]$stm, obs, example_cp)
```

## 6.4a STM contribution of different components (model only)
```{r}

# ============================================================
# DAILY STM COMPONENTS
# All compartments × all parameters = 35 plots
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(workflows)
library(recipes)
library(readr)

# ============================================================
# 1. Settings
# ============================================================

compartments_to_plot <- names(fits)

parameters_to_plot <- c(
  "PBmax",
  "alpha",
  "Eopt",
  "Kd",
  "chl_surface"
)

# Folder for plots and extracted component data
component_output_dir <- "stm_component_plots"

dir.create(
  component_output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Function to extract components for one combination
# ============================================================

extract_daily_stm_components <- function(
    fits,
    compartment_selected,
    parameter_selected
) {

  message(
    "Extracting compartment ",
    compartment_selected,
    ", parameter ",
    parameter_selected
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract fitted workflow
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  wf <- fits[[compartment_selected]]$
    stm$
    workflows[[parameter_selected]]

  # Modeltime Prophet wrapper
  prophet_model <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(wf)

  # Native Prophet model
  prophet_native <- prophet_model$models$model_1

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Full daily sequence already used by the STM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  daily_dates <- fits[[compartment_selected]]$
    stm$
    params %>%
    select(date) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(date)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # First recipe:
  # create time signatures, Fourier terms and bloom terms
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  workflow_recipe <- workflows::extract_recipe(
    wf,
    estimated = TRUE
  )

  daily_engineered <- recipes::bake(
    workflow_recipe,
    new_data = daily_dates
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Second recipe:
  # prepare engineered variables for native Prophet
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  xreg_recipe <- prophet_model$extras$xreg_recipe

  daily_xreg <- recipes::bake(
    xreg_recipe,
    new_data = daily_engineered
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare native Prophet input
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  daily_prophet_data <- daily_xreg %>%
    mutate(
      ds = daily_dates$date,
      .before = 1
    )

  # Match Prophet's internal column naming:
  # dots become underscores and names become lowercase
  names(daily_prophet_data) <- names(daily_prophet_data) %>%
    gsub("\\.", "_", .) %>%
    tolower()

  required_regressors <- names(
    prophet_native$extra_regressors
  )

  missing_regressors <- setdiff(
    required_regressors,
    names(daily_prophet_data)
  )

  if (length(missing_regressors) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing regressors for compartment ",
        compartment_selected,
        ", parameter ",
        parameter_selected,
        ": ",
        paste(
          missing_regressors,
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  daily_prophet_data <- daily_prophet_data %>%
    select(
      ds,
      all_of(required_regressors)
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Predict components on all daily dates
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  component_predictions <- predict(
    prophet_native,
    daily_prophet_data
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Find manual Fourier contributions
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fourier_cols <- names(component_predictions)[
    grepl(
      "^date_(sin|cos)365_25_k[1-5]$",
      names(component_predictions),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (length(fourier_cols) != 10) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "Expected 10 Fourier columns but found ",
        length(fourier_cols),
        " for compartment ",
        compartment_selected,
        ", parameter ",
        parameter_selected
      )
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate total seasonality
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  component_predictions <- component_predictions %>%
    mutate(
      seasonality_fourier = rowSums(
        across(all_of(fourier_cols)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

  if ("yearly" %in% names(component_predictions)) {

    component_predictions <- component_predictions %>%
      mutate(
        seasonality_prophet = yearly,

        seasonality =
          seasonality_fourier +
          seasonality_prophet
      )

  } else {

    component_predictions <- component_predictions %>%
      mutate(
        seasonality_prophet = 0,
        seasonality = seasonality_fourier
      )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Return selected component data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  component_predictions %>%
    transmute(
      date = as.Date(ds),

      compartment = as.character(
        compartment_selected
      ),

      parameter = parameter_selected,

      long_term_trend = trend,

      seasonality_fourier,
      seasonality_prophet,
      seasonality,

      bloom1,
      bloom2,

      fitted_log = yhat,
      fitted_log_lower = yhat_lower,
      fitted_log_upper = yhat_upper,
      fitted_original_scale = exp(yhat),
      fitted_original_lower = exp(yhat_lower),
      fitted_original_upper = exp(yhat_upper)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Create all compartment-parameter combinations
# ============================================================

component_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  compartment = compartments_to_plot,
  parameter = parameters_to_plot
)

component_grid

# This should contain 35 rows
nrow(component_grid)

# ============================================================
# 4. Extract the components for all 35 combinations
# ============================================================

all_stm_components <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  component_grid$compartment,
  component_grid$parameter,

  function(compartment, parameter) {

    extract_daily_stm_components(
      fits = fits,
      compartment_selected = compartment,
      parameter_selected = parameter
    )
  }
)

# ============================================================
# 5. Sanity checks
# ============================================================

# Number of compartment-parameter combinations
all_stm_components %>%
  distinct(compartment, parameter) %>%
  nrow()

# Expected: 35

# Number of dates per combination
component_counts <- all_stm_components %>%
  count(
    compartment,
    parameter,
    name = "n_dates"
  )

print(
  component_counts,
  n = Inf
)

# ============================================================
# Convert to long format
# ============================================================

all_stm_components_long <- all_stm_components %>%
  select(
    date,
    compartment,
    parameter,
    long_term_trend,
    seasonality,
    bloom1,
    bloom2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      long_term_trend,
      seasonality,
      bloom1,
      bloom2
    ),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "contribution"
  )

# ============================================================
# Create 35 plots and save them
# ============================================================

for(comp in compartments_to_plot){

  for(par in parameters_to_plot){

    p <- all_stm_components_long %>%
      filter(
        compartment == comp,
        parameter == par
      ) %>%
      ggplot(
        aes(date, contribution)
      ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        colour = "grey70"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        colour = "steelblue4",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ component,
        scales = "free_y",
        ncol = 1
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "STM components",
          par,
          "- compartment",
          comp
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Contribution"
      )

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        component_output_dir,
        paste0(
          "STM_components_",
          par,
          "_compartment_",
          comp,
          ".png"
        )
      ),
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = 8,
      dpi = 300
    )

  }
}
```

## 6.4b Calculating a confidence interval around the yearly estimates

```{r}
pp_uncertainty_input <- all_stm_components %>%
  filter(compartment == "1") %>%
  select(
    date,
    parameter,
    fitted_original_scale,
    fitted_original_lower,
    fitted_original_upper
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = c(
      fitted_original_scale,
      fitted_original_lower,
      fitted_original_upper
    )
  )

pp_uncertainty_input <- pp_uncertainty_input %>%
  left_join(
    PAR %>%
      select(date, PAR),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bottomdepth = 10
  )

pp_uncertainty <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  pp_uncertainty_input,

  function(
    date,
    fitted_original_scale_PBmax,
    fitted_original_scale_alpha,
    fitted_original_scale_Eopt,
    fitted_original_scale_Kd,
    fitted_original_scale_chl_surface,

    fitted_original_lower_PBmax,
    fitted_original_lower_alpha,
    fitted_original_lower_Eopt,
    fitted_original_lower_Kd,
    fitted_original_lower_chl_surface,

    fitted_original_upper_PBmax,
    fitted_original_upper_alpha,
    fitted_original_upper_Eopt,
    fitted_original_upper_Kd,
    fitted_original_upper_chl_surface,

    PAR,
    bottomdepth
  ) {

    pp_est <- compute_daily_PP_realcols(
      date,
      fitted_original_scale_PBmax,
      fitted_original_scale_alpha,
      fitted_original_scale_Eopt,
      fitted_original_scale_Kd,
      fitted_original_scale_chl_surface,
      PAR,
      bottomdepth = bottomdepth,
      dz = 0.25,
      hours = 24
    )$PP_model[[1]]

    pp_low <- compute_daily_PP_realcols(
      date,
      fitted_original_lower_PBmax,
      fitted_original_lower_alpha,
      fitted_original_lower_Eopt,
      fitted_original_lower_Kd,
      fitted_original_lower_chl_surface,
      PAR,
      bottomdepth = bottomdepth,
      dz = 0.25,
      hours = 24
    )$PP_model[[1]]

    pp_up <- compute_daily_PP_realcols(
      date,
      fitted_original_upper_PBmax,
      fitted_original_upper_alpha,
      fitted_original_upper_Eopt,
      fitted_original_upper_Kd,
      fitted_original_upper_chl_surface,
      PAR,
      bottomdepth = bottomdepth,
      dz = 0.25,
      hours = 24
    )$PP_model[[1]]

    tibble(
      date = date,
      PP_estimate = pp_est,
      PP_lower = pp_low,
      PP_upper = pp_up
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SHAPLEY CONTRIBUTIONS TO DAILY PP
#
# Four Shapley components:
#   1. Long-term trend
#   2. Seasonality
#   3. Bloom 1
#   4. Bloom 2
#
# Other time regressors are retained as the fixed background.
#
# Test:
#   Compartment 1
#   2020-01-01 onward
#
# Requires existing objects:
#   all_stm_components
#   PAR
#   compute_daily_PP_realcols()
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# 1. Settings
# ============================================================

components_to_decompose <- c(
  "long_term_trend",
  "seasonality",
  "bloom1",
  "bloom2"
)

parameters_needed <- c(
  "PBmax",
  "alpha",
  "Eopt",
  "Kd",
  "chl_surface"
)

# compartment_selected <- "1"
# start_date <- as.Date("2020-01-01")

default_bottomdepth <- 10
dz_value <- 0.25
hours_value <- 24

# ============================================================
# 2. Calculate the contribution of other time regressors
# ============================================================

pp_component_data <- all_stm_components %>%
  mutate(
    other_regressors =
      fitted_log -
      long_term_trend -
      seasonality -
      bloom1 -
      bloom2
  # ) %>%
  # filter(
  #   compartment == compartment_selected,
  #   date >= start_date
  )

# ============================================================
# 3. Check reconstruction on the log-parameter scale
# ============================================================

reconstruction_check_parameters <- pp_component_data %>%
  mutate(
    reconstructed_log =
      long_term_trend +
      seasonality +
      bloom1 +
      bloom2 +
      other_regressors,

    difference =
      fitted_log -
      reconstructed_log
  )

summary(reconstruction_check_parameters$difference)

# Expected: zero or extremely close to zero

# ============================================================
# 4. Convert parameter components to wide format
# ============================================================

pp_components_wide <- pp_component_data %>%
  select(
    date,
    compartment,
    parameter,
    long_term_trend,
    seasonality,
    bloom1,
    bloom2,
    other_regressors
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = c(
      long_term_trend,
      seasonality,
      bloom1,
      bloom2,
      other_regressors
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{parameter}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

# ============================================================
# 5. Add PAR and bottom depth
# ============================================================

pp_components_wide <- pp_components_wide %>%
  left_join(
    PAR %>%
      select(date, PAR) %>%
      distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bottomdepth = default_bottomdepth
  )

# Check missing PAR
pp_components_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    missing_PAR = sum(is.na(PAR))
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. Create parameter values for a coalition
# ============================================================

make_parameters_for_coalition <- function(
    data,
    active_components
) {

  out <- data

  for (parameter_name in parameters_needed) {

    # Other regressors are the fixed background
    baseline_column <- paste0(
      "other_regressors_",
      parameter_name
    )

    log_value <- out[[baseline_column]]

    # Add the active Shapley components
    for (component_name in active_components) {

      component_column <- paste0(
        component_name,
        "_",
        parameter_name
      )

      log_value <- log_value + out[[component_column]]
    }

    # Back-transform parameter to original scale
    out[[parameter_name]] <- exp(log_value)
  }

  out
}

# ============================================================
# 7. Calculate daily PP for one coalition
# ============================================================

calculate_pp_for_coalition <- function(
    data,
    active_components,
    coalition_key
) {

  parameter_data <- make_parameters_for_coalition(
    data = data,
    active_components = active_components
  )

  pp_values <- purrr::pmap_dbl(
    parameter_data %>%
      select(
        date,
        PBmax,
        alpha,
        Eopt,
        Kd,
        chl_surface,
        PAR,
        bottomdepth
      ),

    function(
        date,
        PBmax,
        alpha,
        Eopt,
        Kd,
        chl_surface,
        PAR,
        bottomdepth
    ) {

      input_values <- c(
        PBmax,
        alpha,
        Eopt,
        Kd,
        chl_surface,
        PAR,
        bottomdepth
      )

      if (any(is.na(input_values))) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }

      pp_result <- compute_daily_PP_realcols(
        date,
        PBmax,
        alpha,
        Eopt,
        Kd,
        chl_surface,
        PAR,
        bottomdepth = bottomdepth,
        dz = dz_value,
        hours = hours_value
      )

      pp_result$PP_model[[1]]
    }
  )

  tibble(
    date = parameter_data$date,
    compartment = parameter_data$compartment,
    coalition = coalition_key,
    PP_model = pp_values
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Helper for coalition names
# ============================================================

get_coalition_key <- function(components) {

  if (length(components) == 0) {
    return("none")
  }

  paste(
    sort(components),
    collapse = "+"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 9. Generate all 16 coalitions
# ============================================================

coalition_table <- expand_grid(
  long_term_trend = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  seasonality = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  bloom1 = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  bloom2 = c(FALSE, TRUE)
)

coalition_table$active_components <- purrr::pmap(
  coalition_table,
  function(
      long_term_trend,
      seasonality,
      bloom1,
      bloom2
  ) {

    component_flags <- c(
      long_term_trend = long_term_trend,
      seasonality = seasonality,
      bloom1 = bloom1,
      bloom2 = bloom2
    )

    names(component_flags)[component_flags]
  }
)

coalition_table <- coalition_table %>%
  mutate(
    coalition_key = map_chr(
      active_components,
      get_coalition_key
    )
  )

coalition_table %>%
  select(coalition_key)

# ============================================================
# 10. Calculate daily PP for all coalitions
# ============================================================

pp_by_coalition <- map2_dfr(
  coalition_table$active_components,
  coalition_table$coalition_key,

  function(active_components, coalition_key) {

    message(
      "Calculating coalition: ",
      coalition_key
    )

    calculate_pp_for_coalition(
      data = pp_components_wide,
      active_components = active_components,
      coalition_key = coalition_key
    )
  }
)

# ============================================================
# 11. Convert coalition PP to wide format
# ============================================================

pp_coalition_wide <- pp_by_coalition %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = coalition,
    values_from = PP_model,
    names_prefix = "coalition__"
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. Exact Shapley decomposition
# ============================================================

n_components <- length(components_to_decompose)

shapley_results <- map_dfr(
  components_to_decompose,

  function(target_component) {

    other_components <- setdiff(
      components_to_decompose,
      target_component
    )

    # Generate all subsets not containing target_component
    subset_list <- unlist(
      lapply(
        0:length(other_components),

        function(subset_size) {

          if (subset_size == 0) {
            return(list(character(0)))
          }

          combn(
            other_components,
            subset_size,
            simplify = FALSE
          )
        }
      ),
      recursive = FALSE
    )

    weighted_differences <- map_dfc(
      seq_along(subset_list),

      function(i) {

        subset_components <- subset_list[[i]]

        subset_with_target <- c(
          subset_components,
          target_component
        )

        key_without <- get_coalition_key(
          subset_components
        )

        key_with <- get_coalition_key(
          subset_with_target
        )

        column_without <- paste0(
          "coalition__",
          key_without
        )

        column_with <- paste0(
          "coalition__",
          key_with
        )

        subset_size <- length(subset_components)

        shapley_weight <-
          factorial(subset_size) *
          factorial(
            n_components -
              subset_size -
              1
          ) /
          factorial(n_components)

        pp_without <-
          pp_coalition_wide[[column_without]]

        pp_with <-
          pp_coalition_wide[[column_with]]

        tibble(
          contribution =
            shapley_weight *
            (pp_with - pp_without)
        )
      }
    )

    tibble(
      date = pp_coalition_wide$date,
      compartment = pp_coalition_wide$compartment,
      component = target_component,

      PP_contribution = rowSums(
        weighted_differences,
        na.rm = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
)

# ============================================================
# 13. Add background and full PP
# ============================================================

background_column <- "coalition__none"

full_coalition_key <- get_coalition_key(
  components_to_decompose
)

full_column <- paste0(
  "coalition__",
  full_coalition_key
)

pp_background_and_full <- pp_coalition_wide %>%
  transmute(
    date,
    compartment,

    PP_background =
      .data[[background_column]],

    PP_full =
      .data[[full_column]]
  )

daily_pp_shapley <- shapley_results %>%
  left_join(
    pp_background_and_full,
    by = c(
      "date",
      "compartment"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 14. Check exact reconstruction
# ============================================================

pp_shapley_check <- daily_pp_shapley %>%
  group_by(
    date,
    compartment
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    PP_background = first(PP_background),
    PP_full = first(PP_full),

    shapley_sum = sum(
      PP_contribution
    ),

    PP_reconstructed =
      PP_background +
      shapley_sum,

    difference =
      PP_full -
      PP_reconstructed,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(pp_shapley_check$difference)

# Expected: zero or extremely close to zero

# ============================================================
# 15. Give components readable names
# ============================================================

daily_pp_shapley <- daily_pp_shapley %>%
  mutate(
    component = factor(
      component,

      levels = c(
        "long_term_trend",
        "seasonality",
        "bloom1",
        "bloom2"
      ),

      labels = c(
        "Long-term trend",
        "Seasonality",
        "Bloom 1",
        "Bloom 2"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 16. Plot four Shapley contributions
# ============================================================

p_shapley <- ggplot(
  daily_pp_shapley,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = PP_contribution
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey65"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    colour = "steelblue4",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ component,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Shapley contributions to daily PP: compartment ",
      compartment_selected
    ),
    subtitle =
      "Other time regressors retained as the fixed background",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Shapley contribution to daily PP"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_shapley

# ============================================================
# 17. Save test figure and results
# ============================================================

dir.create(
  "pp_component_plots",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    "pp_component_plots",
    paste0(
      "daily_PP_shapley_compartment_",
      compartment_selected,
      "_2020_2024.png"
    )
  ),
  plot = p_shapley,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

write_csv(
  daily_pp_shapley,
  file.path(
    "pp_component_plots",
    paste0(
      "daily_PP_shapley_compartment_",
      compartment_selected,
      "_2020_2024.csv"
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PP fit for STM with new bloom times
# ============================================================

pp_fit_new_peaks <- map_dfr(names(preds), function(cp) {

  # Monthly observed PP
  obs_monthly <- obs %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      compartment = as.character(compartment),
      year = year(date),
      month = month(date)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      compartment == as.character(cp),
      !is.na(PP_observed)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      compartment,
      year,
      month
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      PP_observed_monthly = mean(PP_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Monthly STM predictions using the new bloom times
  pred_monthly <- preds[[cp]]$stm %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      compartment = as.character(compartment),
      year = year(date),
      month = month(date)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      compartment == as.character(cp),
      !is.na(PP_model)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      compartment,
      year,
      month
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      PP_model = mean(PP_model, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Keep only months with both observed and predicted PP
  matched <- inner_join(
    obs_monthly,
    pred_monthly,
    by = c(
      "compartment",
      "year",
      "month"
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(PP_observed),
      is.finite(PP_model)
    )

  # Calculate PP fit
  tibble(
    compartment = as.character(cp),

    R2 = yardstick::rsq_vec(
      truth = matched$PP_observed,
      estimate = matched$PP_model,
      na_rm = TRUE
    ),

    RMSE = yardstick::rmse_vec(
      truth = matched$PP_observed,
      estimate = matched$PP_model,
      na_rm = TRUE
    ),

    MAE = yardstick::mae_vec(
      truth = matched$PP_observed,
      estimate = matched$PP_model,
      na_rm = TRUE
    ),

    n = nrow(matched)
  )
})

pp_fit_new_peaks
```

```{r}
## Comparison statistics

vars <- c("PBmax", "alpha", "Eopt", "Kd", "chl_surface")

r2_all <- map_dfr(comps, function(cp) {

  map_dfr(vars, function(v) {

    obs_fit <- filter(pp_all, compartment == cp) %>%
      select(date, obs = all_of(v)) %>%
      left_join(
        fits[[cp]]$stm$params %>%
          select(date, fit = all_of(v)),
        by = "date"
      )

    obs_fit_nobloom <- filter(pp_all, compartment == cp) %>%
      select(date, obs = all_of(v)) %>%
      left_join(
        fits_nobloom[[cp]]$stm$params %>%
          select(date, fit = all_of(v)),
        by = "date"
      )

    tibble(
      compartment = cp,
      parameter = v,
      R2_bloom = cor(obs_fit$obs, obs_fit$fit,
                     use = "complete.obs")^2,
      R2_nobloom = cor(obs_fit_nobloom$obs, obs_fit_nobloom$fit,
                       use = "complete.obs")^2
    )
  })
})

r2_all


pp_r2_all <- map_dfr(names(preds), function(cp) {

  # STM with blooms
  bloom_data <- preds[[cp]]$stm %>%
    mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)) %>%
    inner_join(
      obs %>%
        mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)),
      by = c("date", "compartment")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(PP_model),
      !is.na(PP_observed)
    )

  # STM without blooms
  nobloom_data <- preds_nobloom[[cp]]$stm %>%
    mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)) %>%
    inner_join(
      obs %>%
        mutate(compartment = as.character(compartment)),
      by = c("date", "compartment")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(PP_model),
      !is.na(PP_observed)
    )

  tibble(
    compartment = cp,
    model = c("STM with blooms", "STM without blooms"),
    R2 = c(
      yardstick::rsq_vec(
        truth = bloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = bloom_data$PP_model
      ),
      yardstick::rsq_vec(
        truth = nobloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = nobloom_data$PP_model
      )
    ),
    RMSE = c(
      yardstick::rmse_vec(
        truth = bloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = bloom_data$PP_model
      ),
      yardstick::rmse_vec(
        truth = nobloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = nobloom_data$PP_model
      )
    ),
    MAE = c(
      yardstick::mae_vec(
        truth = bloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = bloom_data$PP_model
      ),
      yardstick::mae_vec(
        truth = nobloom_data$PP_observed,
        estimate = nobloom_data$PP_model
      )
    ),

  )
```

# 7. Reproduceerbaarheid & aannames

- **PAR‑conversie**: $f_{PAR}$ en $\kappa$ zijn benaderingen; kies
  sitespecifiek indien beschikbaar (sensor‑spectrum/kalibratie).
  citeturn12search41turn12search38
- **Dagelijkse integratie**: we gebruiken $\overline{I}_0$
  (daggemiddelde). Een diurnale curve of daglicht‑uren kan worden
  toegevoegd.
- **Chlorofyl‑profiel**: aangenomen **uniform**; kan worden uitgebreid
  met $C_{chl}(z)$.
- **STM**: componenten trend/seizoen/bloom zijn additief en worden
  **log‑schaal** gemodelleerd; zie Prophet‑referenties.
  citeturn12search30turn12search35
- **GAM**: seizoenscomponent is **cyclisch** via `bs='cc'`.
  citeturn12search25turn12search29 \`\`\`
  
  
# 8. Leave one year out for validation
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Leave-one-year-out validation
# Fit models while hiding all measurements from validation_year
# ============================================================

validation_year <- 2024

parameters_to_model <- c(
  "PBmax",
  "alpha",
  "Eopt",
  "Kd",
  "chl_surface"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Store the real measurements from the validation year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

validation_truth <- pp_all %>%
  mutate(
    compartment = as.character(compartment),
    date = as.Date(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year(date) == validation_year
  ) %>%
  select(
    compartment,
    date,
    all_of(parameters_to_model)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Hide the validation-year measurements from the models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pp_validation <- pp_all %>%
  mutate(
    compartment = as.character(compartment),
    date = as.Date(date),
    across(
      all_of(parameters_to_model),
      as.numeric
    ),
    across(
      all_of(parameters_to_model),
      ~ if_else(
        year(date) == validation_year,
        NA_real_,
        .x
      )
    )
  )


# Confirm that all parameter measurements are hidden
validation_check <- pp_validation %>%
  filter(
    year(date) == validation_year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(parameters_to_model),
      ~ all(is.na(.x))
    )
  )

print(validation_check)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit validation models by compartment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fits_validation <- purrr::map(
  comps,
  function(cp) {

    d <- pp_validation %>%
      filter(
        compartment == as.character(cp)
      )

    list(
      lm = fit_model_tidy_realcols(
        df = d,
        model = "lm"
      ),
    
      gam = fit_model_tidy_realcols(
        df = d,
        model = "gam"
      ),
    
      stm = fit_model_tidy_realcols(
        df = d,
        model = "stm",
        stm_cfg = list(
          fourier_K = p$stm_fourier_K,
          bloom1_center = p$stm_bloom1_center,
          bloom1_sigma = p$stm_bloom1_sigma,
          bloom2_center = p$stm_bloom2_center,
          bloom2_sigma = p$stm_bloom2_sigma
        )
      ),
    
      stm_no_bloom2 = fit_model_tidy_realcols(
        df = d,
        model = "stm",
        stm_cfg = list(
          fourier_K = p$stm_fourier_K,
          bloom1_center = p$stm_bloom1_center,
          bloom1_sigma = p$stm_bloom1_sigma,
          bloom2_center = p$stm_bloom2_center,
          bloom2_sigma = p$stm_bloom2_sigma,
    
          include_bloom2 = FALSE
        )
      ), 
      
      stm_no_trend = fit_model_tidy_realcols_notrend(
        df = d,
        model = "stm",
        stm_cfg = list(
          fourier_K = p$stm_fourier_K,
          bloom1_center = p$stm_bloom1_center,
          bloom1_sigma = p$stm_bloom1_sigma,
          bloom2_center = p$stm_bloom2_center,
          bloom2_sigma = p$stm_bloom2_sigma,
      
          include_trend = FALSE
        )
      )
      )
  }
)

names(fits_validation) <- as.character(comps)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot validation-year PP and calculate model fit
# ============================================================


plot_pp_validation <- function(pred_df, obs_df, cp, model_name, validation_year) {

  pred_sel <- pred_df %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    filter(year(date) == validation_year) %>%
    select(date, PP_model)

  obs_sel <- obs_df %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      compartment = as.character(compartment)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      compartment == as.character(cp),
      year(date) == validation_year,
      !is.na(PP_observed)
    ) %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarise(
      PP_observed = mean(PP_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Match predictions and observations
  comparison <- inner_join(
    pred_sel,
    obs_sel,
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(PP_model),
      is.finite(PP_observed)
    )

  # Calculate validation metrics
  metrics <- comparison %>%
    summarise(
      R2 = cor(PP_observed, PP_model)^2,
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((PP_observed - PP_model)^2)),
      MAE = mean(abs(PP_observed - PP_model)),
      n = n()
    )

  metric_label <- paste0(
    "R² = ", round(metrics$R2, 3),
    "\nRMSE = ", round(metrics$RMSE, 1),
    "\nMAE = ", round(metrics$MAE, 1),
    "\nn = ", metrics$n
  )

  # Time-series plot
  p_time <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = pred_sel,
      aes(date, PP_model, colour = "Model"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = obs_sel,
      aes(date, PP_observed, colour = "Observed"),
      alpha = 0.7,
      size = 1.8
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = min(pred_sel$date, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = Inf,
      label = metric_label,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1.1,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        Model = "#1f77b4",
        Observed = "#d62728"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        model_name,
        "| Compartment",
        cp,
        "| Validation year",
        validation_year
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(
        "Depth-integrated PP (mg C m"^{-2}~d^{-1}*")"
      ),
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # Observed-versus-predicted XY plot
  p_xy <- ggplot(
    comparison,
    aes(x = PP_observed, y = PP_model)
  ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      colour = "#1f77b4",
      alpha = 0.7,
      size = 2
    ) +
    #coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = expression(
        "Observed PP (mg C m"^{-2}~d^{-1}*")"
      ),
      y = expression(
        "Predicted PP (mg C m"^{-2}~d^{-1}*")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # Return the plots side by side
  p_time | p_xy
}
```

```{r}
# Replace STM Kd with observations when available

fits_validation_kdobs <- fits_validation

for(cp in names(fits_validation_kdobs)) {

  fits_validation_kdobs[[cp]]$stm$params <-
    fits_validation_kdobs[[cp]]$stm$params %>%
    left_join(
      kd_obs %>%
        filter(compartment == as.numeric(cp)) %>%
        select(date, Kd_obs),
      by = "date"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Kd = coalesce(Kd_obs, Kd)
    ) %>%
    select(-Kd_obs)

}

        out_dir = NULL,

        hours = p$hours_per_day,
```

```{r}
plot_pp_all_years <- function(pred_df, obs_df, cp, model_name) {

    summarise(
      PP_observed = mean(PP_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  comparison <- inner_join(
    pred_sel,
    obs_sel,
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(PP_model),
      is.finite(PP_observed)
    )

  metrics <- comparison %>%
    summarise(
      R2   = cor(PP_observed, PP_model)^2,
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((PP_observed - PP_model)^2)),
      MAE  = mean(abs(PP_observed - PP_model)),
      n    = n()
    )

  metric_label <- paste0(
    "R² = ", round(metrics$R2, 3),

      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    annotate(

        "| All years"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(
        "Depth-integrated PP (mg C m"^{-2}~d^{-1}*")"
      ),
      colour = NULL
    ) +

    comparison,

      x = PP_observed,
      y = PP_model

      ),
      y = expression(
        "Predicted PP (mg C m"^{-2}~d^{-1}*")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  p_time | p_xy +
    plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1))
}
```
